bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; modifying the general assistance standard of assistance; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256D.01, subdivision 1b.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256D.01, subdivision 1b, is amended to read:

Subd. 1b.
Rules; standard of assistance.
The commissioner shall adopt rules to set standards of assistance and methods of calculating payment to conform with subdivision 1a. When a recipient is a resident of a licensed residential facility, except shelters for the homeless or shelters under section 611A.31, the recipient is not eligible for a full general assistance standard. The state standard of assistance for recipients who reside in a licensed residential facility and have personal needs not otherwise provided for is:

(1) 70 percent of the general assistance standard for recipients receiving housing assistance under chapter 256I and residing in a licensed residential facility under section 256I.04, subdivision 2a, paragraph (a), clause (1) or (2); or

(2) the personal needs allowance authorized for medical assistance recipients under section 256B.35 for recipients residing in other licensed residential facilities.
